metadata.description: Architecture recovery and analysis tools built on arcade-agent

plugins.name: arcade-analyze
plugins.description: Recover, visualize, and improve the architecture of a codebase: component recovery (PKG/WCA/ACDC/ARC/LIMBO), architectural smells as failure points, quality metrics with balanced scores, interactive HTML visualizers with a live agent feedback loop, ranked refactoring recommendations, CI gates, and the arcade-guard guardrail.
